title: Abaco on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This hospitable Grayton Beach Vacation home
description_expanded: This hospitable Grayton Beach Vacation home's perfect placement provides direct views of Western Lake and the sparkling Gulf of Mexico. Up to 14 beach loving guests may reside on vacation in this lovely gracious home that features six bedrooms. The location on a gulf estuary of an exotic coastal dune lake provides panoramic views of natural serenity bordered by sugary dunes beside the beautiful beach. These treasured lakes are found in very few other places in the world and support a huge abundance of natural wildlife due to a mixture of the water's composition. Access from the property invites you to paddle around and fish for a while. Although you will feel like you are in a remote wonderful world of your own, this old Grayton Beach locale is just a short stroll away from galleries, restaurants, and favorite destinations like the lively Red Bar . However, you may find it hard to leave this heavenly place since the recently remodeled wraparound columned porches and decks overlook such an enchanting setting. A bubbling hot tub on one of them inspires relaxation while relishing the beauty around you. Abaco was featured in Southern Living Magazine and is decorated in a casual yet sophisticated style that simultaneously dovetails comfort with elegance. It is also quite gracious for entertaining, which makes it the perfect choice for a fun family and friend beach reunion. The Great Room incorporates the living and dining portions of the house. These are open to well-equipped kitchen that features two large side by side refrigerators, two dishwashers, two ovens, and a five burner gas burner range. Nearby beside a bar with stools sits a large round dining table with eight sleek high backed cloth chairs beneath an elegant vintage chandelier. The Great Room has a wall of creamy white custom cabinetry and a Wet Bar with an ice maker. A wall of windows includes two sets of double glass doors that frame the sensational scenery and lead to the beach side porch. A Bose Surround Sound System accompanies a 50" flat screen TV  with built in Chromecast for added entertainment. Each one of the bedrooms is individually decorated in their own style but share a devotion to comfort. They also all come with a private en suite bath. A colorful half bath serves as a convenient powder room off the living area. Two of the Guest Bedrooms are on the first floor, and one of them is great for kids with a queen sized bunk bed and individual TVs. All of the other Guest Bedrooms include king-sized beds and many of them also have double glass doors leading to a porch balcony. The spacious Master Bedroom also has a king sized bed along with a window wall, a breezy porch with stunning views, a sitting area and a luxury bath with double vanities, a dual head shower as well as a soaking tub. This Grayton Beach location is in the heart of everything on South Walton's Scenic 30A with lots of great restaurants, friendly beach bars, galleries, specialty shops, seasonal festivals and other delightful diversions found in all the picture-perfect coastal villages nearby. First Floor:  Covered Parking. Second Floor:  Living Room with Wet Bar and Balcony Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bunk Room with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room, Laundry. Third Floor:  King Master Suite with Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub + Balcony Access, King Master Suite with Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub + Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo.
